VERDICT 1: REJECT
The first solution incorrectly multiplies the count of integer points in one quadrant by four, assuming symmetry without proper calculation. The correct approach involves considering all quadrants, not just one.

VERDICT 2: REJECT
The second solution overcounts by including integer points on the boundary multiple times. It treats each row separately, counting all x-values within a row without excluding boundary points.

VERDICT 3: ACCEPT
The third solution correctly accounts for the dimensions of the original larger rectangle and then subtracts the boundary points of the smaller rectangle, yielding the accurate count of integer points strictly inside.
